sales.name: Net sales
sales.what: Taxable value of tax invoices and paid counter bills in the period, less credit notes and counter returns. Cancelled documents are left out.
sales.formula: invoice lines + counter lines (quantity not returned) - credit note lines, all at taxable value
sales.limits: Counter bills carry no customer, so they are missing from customer rankings.

pieces.name: Pieces sold
pieces.what: Quantity of goods sold in the period, net of returns.
pieces.formula: sum of quantity on the same sale lines, goods only
pieces.limits: Services and trims are not counted as pieces.

bills.name: Bills
bills.what: Number of tax invoices plus paid counter bills in the period.
bills.formula: count(invoices not cancelled) + count(counter bills paid)
bills.limits: Credit notes do not reduce the count.

avgBill.name: Average bill value
avgBill.what: Net sales divided by the number of bills.
avgBill.limits: Sales is net of returns but the bill count is not.

avgRate.name: Average rate per piece
avgRate.what: Net sales divided by pieces sold.
avgRate.limits: Sales includes service lines while pieces counts goods only, so services raise the rate.

grossProfit.name: Gross profit on standard cost
grossProfit.what: Net sales less the standard cost of the goods sold, where standard cost is each item's purchase rate today. The books' trading account remains the place for profit after stock valuation.
grossProfit.formula: net sales - sum(goods quantity x item purchase rate)
grossProfit.limits: Uses the current purchase rate, not the cost the stock was bought at. Service sales carry no cost, so they count as full margin.

profitPct.name: Gross margin
profitPct.what: Gross profit as a percentage of net sales.
profitPct.limits: Blank when there are no sales in the period.

purchases.name: Purchases
purchases.what: Taxable value of purchase bills in the period. Cancelled bills are left out.
purchases.formula: sum of purchase bill line taxable value

stockValue.name: Stock value
stockValue.what: Value of stock on hand at the end of the period, by the business's chosen valuation method.
stockValue.formula: stock summary as at the period end date
stockValue.limits: Stock is not posted to the ledger, so this cannot be compared with a ledger balance.

receivable.name: Receivables
receivable.what: What customers owe at the end of the period: the sum of positive customer balances.
receivable.formula: sum of outstanding balances above zero, receivable side, as at the end date
receivable.limits: Customers who have paid in advance (negative balances) are not netted off.

payable.name: Payables
payable.what: What the business owes suppliers at the end of the period: the sum of positive supplier balances.
payable.formula: sum of outstanding balances above zero, payable side, as at the end date
payable.limits: Advances paid to suppliers are not netted off.

lastYear.name: Same period last year
lastYear.what: Every comparison on the insights page is to the same dates one year earlier.
lastYear.formula: from and to shifted back one calendar year
lastYear.limits: A leap day can make the two periods differ by one day.

gstfile.noImport: No GSTR-2B statement has been imported for this period, so credit is taken from the books. Import the statement under GST compliance.

rows.queried: Held back: queried with the supplier
rows.notAvailable: Held back: statement says not available
rows.inStatementNotInBooks: Held back: on the statement, no bill in the books
rows.inBooksNotInStatement: Waiting: bill in the books, not on the statement

gstcompare.title: GSTR-3B side by side
gstcompare.help: Type what the portal pre-filled and what was finally filed. The differences from the ERP show beside each line. Saving these never reopens the review of the return.

gstamend.title: Amendments to earlier supplies
gstamend.help: Correct an invoice, credit or debit note, or B2C summary from an earlier month. It is reported in this return in the amendment table (B2BA, CDNRA or B2CSA), against the original it replaces.
gstamend.taxableHint: Tax is worked out from the rate.

errors.invalid_period: The return period is not valid.
errors.invalid_gstin: The buyer's GSTIN is not valid.
errors.original_required: Give the number and date of the original.
errors.corrected_required: Give the corrected number and date.
errors.original_not_earlier: The original must be from an earlier month than this return. A correction within the same month is made before filing.
errors.original_period_required: Give the month first reported, as MMYYYY.
errors.note_type_required: Choose credit note or debit note.

flags.rate_differs: Billed rate differs from the order by {diff} a piece.

scorecard.title: Supplier scorecard
scorecard.subtitle: How each supplier did on orders in the range: on time, in full, short and damaged goods, and billed against ordered rates.
scorecard.note: On time counts receipts by the expected date on the order, so orders without one are left out of it. In full is received against ordered. Claim value is short, damaged and returned goods at the receipt rate.

poApproval.waitingTitle: This order is waiting for approval
poApproval.waitingHelp: It is above the approval limit. Nothing can be received or billed on it until someone with the approve right accepts it.
poApproval.limitHelp: Orders above this value wait for someone with the purchase approve right. People who have that right are never held up by it.

errors.order_not_waiting: This order is not waiting for approval.
errors.reason_required: Give a reason for rejecting it.
errors.order_not_approved: This purchase order has not been approved, so goods cannot be received or billed on it.
errors.invalid_amount: Enter the limit as a rupee amount.

quotes.title: Quote comparison
quotes.subtitle: Prices suppliers have quoted for one item, side by side, cheapest landed cost first.
quotes.pick: Choose an item to compare its quotes.
quotes.none: No quotes recorded for this item.
quotes.lastPaid: Last paid {rate} a piece to {supplier} on {date}.
quotes.neverBought: This item has not been bought before.
quotes.note2: Landed cost is the quoted rate plus the freight and other cost you expect, before GST, because GST on purchases is recovered as credit. Expired quotes are shown last and never marked cheapest.

errors.valid_before_quoted: The quote cannot be valid until a date before it was given.
errors.unknown_supplier: Choose a supplier from the list.
errors.unknown_item: Choose an item from the list.

reconOverview.title: Reconciliation overview
reconOverview.subtitle: Every place the books must agree with something else, in one list.

overall.ok: Everything that could be compared agrees.
overall.differs: Something does not agree. Open the rows marked Differs.

customers.name: Customers
customers.what: Customer ledgers against the receivables report.

suppliers.name: Suppliers
suppliers.what: Supplier ledgers against the payables report.

stock.name: Stock
stock.what: Stock register value against the stock ledger.

bank.name: Bank
bank.what: Bank statement lines not yet matched to an entry.

gst.name: GST credit
gst.what: Input credit in the books against the GSTR-2B statement for {period}.

reconOverview.note: A difference of a rupee is treated as rounding. Customers and suppliers can differ when a party has paid in advance, because the report settles payments against bills. Bank has no second figure: it counts statement lines still waiting to be matched.

recurring.title: Recurring entries
recurring.subtitle: Rent, loan instalments, subscriptions and other entries that repeat. They post as ordinary vouchers.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.dayHint: A day past the end of a short month falls on its last day.
recurring.note: Each due date posts one voucher, once; pressing the button again never posts the same date twice. A date that cannot be posted, for example in a locked period, stays due and is shown here. Entries before today catch up, up to a year at a time.

errors.at_least_two_lines: An entry needs a debit and a credit.
errors.voucher_not_balanced: Debit and credit must be the same amount.
errors.ends_before_start: The end date is before the start date.

reservations.title: Stock set aside for this order
reservations.help: Setting aside takes only what is free, in line order. Delivering a line lets its stock go by itself. It stops other orders from taking the same pieces; it does not lock the godown.

errors.order_not_open: This order is closed or cancelled, so no stock can be set aside for it.

backorders.title: Backorders
backorders.subtitle: What open orders want that no stock has been set aside for.
backorders.empty: No order is waiting for stock.
backorders.note: Free stock is normally set aside from the order page, so most of what is left here is stock you do not have. Purchase orders waiting for approval are not counted as arriving.

bins.title: Bins
bins.subtitle: Where pieces sit inside a godown. A bin is a place, not a second stock count.
bins.none: No bins in this godown yet.
bins.unplacedTitle: In stock, not in any bin
bins.allPlaced: Everything in stock has a bin.

errors.bin_exists: That bin code already exists in this godown.
errors.more_than_unplaced: That is more than is in stock and not already in a bin.
errors.more_than_in_bin: That is more than the bin holds.
errors.bin_not_empty: Empty the bin before removing it.
errors.different_warehouse: Bins must be in the same godown.
errors.unknown_warehouse: Choose a godown from the list.

picking.subtitle: The walk through the bins for an order, checked by scanning.
picking.emptyHint: Make one from a sales order once stock is set aside for it.
picking.unplaced: Lines with no bin: {count}. The picker has to find them in the godown.

result.wrong: {code} is not on this list. Put it back.

picking.doneShort: Picking is done, with lines short.

errors.order_not_open: This order is closed or cancelled.

errors.unknown_warehouse: Choose a godown from the list.

errors.evidence_file_not_found: The photo could not be found. Attach it again.

inspection.title: Return inspection
inspection.subtitle: Goods customers sent back, waiting in Quality hold to be restocked or written off.
inspection.inspectFirst: Inspect the goods before they go back on the shelf
inspection.note: Tick the inspect option when recording a return or a credit note for goods. Those goods go to Quality hold instead of the shelf, so they cannot be sold until you decide. A large write-off may wait for an approver. What you do not decide stays on hold.

errors.nothing_decided: Enter how many to restock or write off.
errors.more_than_remaining: That is more than is still waiting.
errors.restock_godown_required: Choose a godown to restock into.
errors.unknown_warehouse: Choose a different godown to restock into.

gstr9.basisHint: Your accountant decides this. Both figures are shown below.
